[[File:Assembly_Chamber.png|thumb|right|200px|An Assembly Chamber]]
The '''Assembly Chamber''' were machines capable of constructing, enhancing and modifying [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]]. Their origins were not entirely known, but some dated as far back as the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Exodus. In addition, their design methodology was similar to those used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Eventually, they came to be considered a highly rare form of technology within the known worlds. According to ancient records, such assemblers were primarily used in the shifting of crystalline resonances which were used in powering [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. As a result, it allowed traditional holocrons to be used by other beings, even if the user was not a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Assembly Chamber}}</ref>
